model_statement: Toy model and actual Kalyna are DIFFERENT experiments

toy.cipher: 16-bit Kalyna-like SPN; two 8-bit columns, 4-bit S-box, GF(16) MDS, 2 internal rounds plus modular terminal whitening
toy.experimental_scope: Exhaustive all 65536 terminal keys per trial; toy cipher, NOT standardized Kalyna

real.experimental_scope: For each of several genuine-master-key trials, exhaustive 2^16 values of two selected key bytes; six other bytes of the 64-bit column are held at the TRUE values; NOT full 2^64 exhaustive search

per_trial.experimental_scope: Exhaustive ALL 2^16 candidate values in the selected two-byte slice of one 64-bit terminal-key column; OTHER SIX BYTES are FIXED at their TRUE values, not a 2^64 exhaustive search
